ican.text: I can explain the main ideas and use the notation for composite and inverse functions.
I can apply these ideas, show my working and check the result.

ku.text: The composite $(f\circ g)(x)=f(g(x))$ applies $g$ first, then $f$.
To find an inverse, first ensure the function is one-to-one on its domain, then swap input and output and solve.
The domain of the inverse equals the range of the original function.
